Fill score—
For singing experiments: headphones will give the cleanest test. With speakers, the microphone will also hear the reference playback, which can make the graph look more “matched” than your voice really is. That speaker bleed may also be interesting to experiment with.
There is no pitch detector in this prototype. Mode A draws a continuous XY trace and scores how concentrated the fill becomes relative to the expected cycles in the current analyser buffer. Mode C is a strobe bar: phase is mapped across X, mic amplitude becomes black/white, and stable tuning produces higher contrast instead of gray smear. Mode B is still here for comparison.
Microphone capture settings
Changing this while the mic is active restarts microphone capture. “Off” is the better phase experiment; “On” may help when singing against speakers.
